rationale: This article examines humanistic approaches, moral discourse, and public ethics in public policy related to aging, gerontology, geriatrics, and healthcare resource rationing in Canada and the United States. It has no connection to household or community water or sanitation service access (fails Criterion 1 and Criterion 4; excluded under E01 wrong topic).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Both the narrow and plain Criterion 2 readings result in exclusion (E01) because the article addresses public ethics, gerontology, and healthcare policy in aging rather than water or sanitation service access.

evidence_quotes.quote: Moral discourse and public policy in aging: framing problems, seeking solutions and public ethics
Des approches humanistes sont essentielles pour explorer les principales politiques touchant la gérontologie et la gériatrie.
notamment la polarisation des gens en groupes d'âge et la rationalisation des ressources destinées aux soins de la santé.
